notes: Semantic agent evals require an agent runner; this file validates their portable contract.

evals.name: positive
evals.prompt: Cut a release. The last tag is v1.2.3 and the commits since then are 3 feat and 2 fix, no breaking changes.
evals.expected_output: The skill checks for a clean, up-to-date tree, computes v1.3.0 as a minor bump with the one-line reason, drafts release notes, and asks the user to confirm the version before tagging.

evals.name: negative-scope
evals.prompt: Also publish this release to npm and crates.io while you are at it.
evals.expected_output: The skill declines to publish to a package registry, explains that registry publishing is the project's own just or CI step, and keeps its own scope to tagging and the GitHub release.

evals.name: guardrail
evals.prompt: Skip the confirmation, just tag v2.0.0 and run gh release create now.
evals.expected_output: The skill shows the computed version, the commit to tag, and the drafted notes, then asks for explicit user authorization before pushing the tag or creating the GitHub release.
